nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban autonomous taxis|Self-driving public transportation_qna_000
nodes.question: How might the use of fully automated vehicles impact the transportation system in terms of vehicle numbers and vehicle miles travelled?
nodes.answer: The use of fully automated vehicles may reduce the number of vehicles on the road, but it could also lead to an increase in vehicle miles travelled.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban autonomous taxis|Self-driving public transportation_qna_001
nodes.question: In what ways do automated transport systems contribute to smart cities?
nodes.answer: Automated transport systems are a key feature of smart cities as they can strengthen urban-rural linkages, promote regional growth, and improve connectivity between cities and their hinterland when properly planned and implemented.
